profile.name: Prateek Parihar
profile.visa: NZ Open Work Visa valid to Feb 2029

summary: Analytics graduate who learns by building rather than just studying, from a live AI-powered booking platform to automation tools that cut manual reporting time by 70 percent. Background spans automotive engineering, data validation in regulated industries, and customer-facing roles across three countries, with a habit of picking up new tools fast and putting them to work on real problems.

Operations and Agile: AI Tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude

experience.title: Data Logician & Field Services Specialist
bullets: Analyse roadside telemetry and performance data to identify operational root causes and streamline service efficiency.
Maintain high quality incident logs and automated data records to ensure reporting accuracy, metric consistency, and compliance.
Partner with customers and internal operational teams to track performance drivers, protect service KPIs, and improve response outcomes.

experience.title: Customer Insights Specialist, Uber Eats Process
bullets: Led data analysis to identify root causes behind customer experience issues, service bottlenecks, and complaint trends across multiple channels.
Generated weekly operational insight reports for leadership to simplify complexity, highlight dissatisfaction drivers, and prioritise business initiatives.
Maintained knowledge base systems to support continuous process improvement and reduce reliance on manual reporting.

experience.title: Customer Experience and Operations Specialist
bullets: Analysed customer onboarding datasets and commercial performance metrics to map trends and isolate operational bottlenecks.
Transformed fragmented customer feedback into structured, actionable insights to help product and operations teams maximise sales conversion.
Managed day-to-day stakeholder communication to influence operational decisions and ensure initiatives delivered measurable business outcomes.

experience.title: Data Associate
bullets: Validated large-scale healthcare data structures using SQL and Power BI to eliminate reporting gaps and resolve metric inconsistencies.
Executed regular UAT, data quality audits, and custom KPI reporting to improve reporting accuracy and visibility across senior teams.

projects.name: AI Agent for CV and Cover Letter Generation
bullets: Built a Telegram-based AI agent using the Claude API to automatically generate tailored CVs and cover letters from job descriptions in seconds.
Managed the full build-to-deployment pipeline independently, hosting the codebase on GitHub and deploying the application on Railway.

projects.name: Kiwi Budget Tours
bullets: Built and deployed an AI-driven tourism booking platform with a WhatsApp-integrated AI planner, using Voice of Customer insights to shape the product.
Used customer journey analytics and UAT to optimise conversion rates and refine user experience.

projects.name: Fuel Prices and EV Demand in New Zealand
bullets: Conducted a 15-year panel analysis across New Zealand, Norway, China and the US, combined with a 103-respondent consumer survey and a three-month real-world EV ownership trial, to test perception versus reality gaps in EV adoption.
Applied elasticity analysis, Granger causality and ARIMA forecasting, finding that policy instability suppresses EV adoption even when fuel prices remain high.

projects.name: Generative AI Business Process Automation
bullets: Built multi-step AI automation workflows using Claude and the OpenAI API to replace repetitive reporting and drafting tasks, achieving a 70 percent reduction in manual reporting time.
Mapped business processes to identify high-value AI intervention points while preserving human review checkpoints for sensitive outputs.

projects.name: Gilmours Workflow Analysis and Process Redesign
bullets: Conducted stakeholder interviews with drivers, dispatchers and warehouse staff to map the end-to-end delivery process and quantify delays by stage.
Produced a redesign case recommending dynamic route optimisation and automated dispatch scheduling, identifying a credible 20 percent delivery-delay reduction opportunity.

projects.name: Genesis Energy Supply Chain Analysis
bullets: Analysed Genesis Energy's supply chain across fuel procurement, generation, transmission and retail operations serving over 500,000 customers, identifying risks including gas shortages and coal export exposure.

education.degree: Master of Applied Business, Business Analytics
education.note: Coursework focused on predictive modelling, business intelligence, digital transformation, and converting data into commercial business strategy.
Designed and built a solar-powered vehicle as part of a team representing the university at a national engineering championship.

certifications: Power BI + Claude: AI-Powered Modeling with the MCP Connector
additional_experience: Security: contracted across major concerts, sporting and event-day environments, film sets, court security, and bank premises security, managing safety and access control across diverse public and controlled environments.

Warehouse, Retail and Hospitality: worked as a Traffic Controller for Vector Energy, in hotel operations and campground management, in retail operations at Countdown, and in hospitality at Burger King since October 2024, balancing part-time shift work with job search and study commitments.
